sentence: This project studies how chromosomes exchange genetic material during reproduction in maize and whether this differs between male and female.
This project brings scientists together to discuss how the extracellular matrix around cells directs cell growth and repair and how it can be engineered.
This project tests whether the noise in light from an optical parametric oscillator can be pushed below the standard quantum limit.
This project builds a certificate program in microelectronics and nanomanufacturing for military members, veterans and family members.
This project builds a portable sensor that uses light and nanomaterials to detect volatile organic compounds in the air.
This project studies whether the microbes living in ponds and on green frog tadpoles help the frogs handle warm and cold water.
This project builds open software that uses artificial intelligence to turn historical aerial photographs into data that modern geospatial tools can use.
This project builds a learning platform with course modules and hands-on virtual experiments about quantum networking and cryptography.
This project builds mathematical tools to measure the limits of imaging systems that combine optical hardware with computational algorithms.
This project tests a theory of how nucleons are internally structured by measuring their spin with a particle accelerator.
This project uses laser light and deep learning to show how temperature changes in boiling fluids over finned surfaces.
This project studies how cumaceans, small crustaceans that live in marine waters, have adapted to Antarctica by looking at their genes.
This project studies how bacteria make a strong adhesive and which genes and biochemical processes control its strength.
This project uses virtual reality and deep learning to build urban simulations that show the mobility challenges older adults face.
This project studies which genes help Asian rice adapt to irrigated, rainfed lowland and rainfed upland ecosystems.
This project studies which genes control how the angle between leaf and stem changes across the leaves of a maize plant.
This project builds an AI framework that writes text descriptions automatically to improve medical image segmentation.
This project upgrades network and cybersecurity resources to protect sensitive data and support remote instruction and research.
